description: Client-neutral definitions. A native client replays these against the same backend and LiveKit and reports the same result fields.
landing: Launched on a signed-in profile, routed to Test Community #general.
interactive: The #general composer accepts input and at least one message is rendered.

history.note: Each message starts with #<seq>, oldest = 0, so a client can report how far it scrolled.

load.note: A scenario is provisional if the 1-minute load, at either end or at any sample in its window, exceeds low_load_per_cpu x CPUs plus its own expected_self_load. CPU, cold-start and frame numbers from a provisional run don't stand as the baseline.

a_idle.title: Logged in, idle
a_idle.note: readings_at_s are seconds after interactive; the 25 s reading is the one comparable with the native spike's.

a_noinstrument.title: Idle with no debug port or driver: the instrumentation delta
a_noinstrument.note: No interactive signal without a driver, so readings_at_s count from launch.

b_scroll.title: Scroll a channel with large mixed history, upward

c_voice_audio.title: In a voice call, audio only

d_video_grid.title: Receiving 9x 720p cameras and 1x 1080p screen share
d_video_grid.note: One layer per stream: adaptiveStream would otherwise pick a layer to fit each tile, and 'receiving 720p' would not hold. Fails validation, with no metrics, unless every stream is received at exact size and at least min_fps_ratio of the rate.

e_idle_growth.title: 30-minute idle growth
e_idle_growth.note: pss_slope_mb_per_hour fits the whole window; pss_slope_after_10min_mb_per_hour skips start-up settling.

probe_angle_lavapipe.title: Best-effort: idle with ANGLE forced to Mesa lavapipe (the native spike's rasterizer)

variants.warm_cache: Process cold, app files in the page cache
variants.evicted_cache: App files dropped from the page cache first (posix_fadvise DONTNEED; system libraries stay cached)
